title: Chic Townhome in Trendy East Nash
description:
✔️ East Nashville location — minutes to Downtown and Germantown
✔️ Balcony and private patio for outdoor relaxation
✔️ 3 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms — sleeps up to 8
✔️ Queen bunk room for families and groups
✔️ Full kitchen with Keurig and dining for 6
✔️ Two-car garage and private laundry

The space
• Modern three-story townhouse designed for families and group getaways
• Open-concept living room with smart TV and full kitchen for gathering
• Second-floor balcony and first-floor patio for relaxing between adventures
• Spacious layout with three private bedrooms and ensuite bathrooms upstairs
• Perfect for families, friends, and extended Nashville stays

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Open-concept living room with comfortable seating and smart TV
• Furnished second-floor balcony
• Private ground-level patio
• Bright, modern three-story layout

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 8)
• This home includes 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms.
• Bedroom 1 (Primary, 3rd Floor) — Queen bed; ensuite bath with dual vanity and walk-in shower
• Bedroom 2 (3rd Floor) — Queen bed; ensuite bath with shower/tub combo
• Bedroom 3 (1st Floor) — Queen-over-queen bunk bed; adjacent full bathroom
• Baths — Primary ensuite with dual vanity and walk-in shower; second ensuite with shower/tub combo; first-floor full bath; second-floor half bath

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with stainless appliances and basic cookware/serveware
• Keurig coffee maker, blender, and toaster
• Dining table seating 6
• Cookware, bakeware, dishes, utensils, and glassware provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• Private washer and dryer
• High-speed WiFi
• Dedicated workspace
• Smart TV in the living room
• We provide bedding, towels, and a small starter set of essentials

📍 Location Highlights
• Minutes to Downtown Nashville and Broadway
• Close to Germantown, Bicentennial Capitol Mall State Park, and the Nashville Farmers Market
• Easy access to East Nashville restaurants, breweries, and coffee shops
• Convenient to Nissan Stadium, parks, and top Nashville attractions

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Parking: Private 2-car garage; additional lot parking and street parking available (first come, first served)
• Stairs: Three-story townhouse; stairs are required
• Noise: A nearby train may be heard during your stay
• Pet policy: This home is not pet friendly. If evidence of pets is found, an additional cleaning fee may apply.
• Check in is at 4:00 PM and checkout is at 10:00 AM.
